Keyboard shortcuts

All shortcuts also work when navigating with the keyboard inside the picker.

Ctrl + S / Cmd + S
Focus the search field and select the current text.
↑ ↓ ← → , Home & End
Move focus between emojis; ↑ on the first row jumps back to search, while ↓ from the search field (caret at the end) jumps into the first emoji.
Enter / Space
Copy the currently focused emoji to the clipboard.
Escape
Close open overlays/menus, then clear the search field and focus it.
Type any letters or numbers
Adds the characters to the search field even while an emoji stays focused, then re-filters results.
